description: The RYOBI USB Lithium Foam Cutter Kit cuts, shapes and shaves a variety of foam. The dual heat settings give you precision temperature control to adjust based on your project needs. This kit includes 3 tips for a variety of applications. The Hot Wire Tip is ideal for carving, slicing, or shaping foam such as upholstery foam when up-cycling furniture. The Precision Engraving Tip adds texture or detail to your designs. The Holing Tip is ideal for cutting out shapes or hole digging into Styrofoam. Eliminate downtime with the convenient tool-free tip change. This Foam Cuter is compatible with the 2 PC. Tip Kit (A81FC07) and Replacement Nichrome Wire (A81FC06). Pair the USB Lithium Foam Cutter with the Hobby Station (RHS01) for ultimate control and precision (sold separately). The included USB Lithium 2Ah battery features a USB-C port that also charges mobile devices, and a LED fuel gauge that clearly indicates the battery level status with the press of a button, eliminating guess work. This product also features an LED indicator to signal when the battery is charged (green) or has low battery (red) while in-use. Best of all, it is part of the RYOBI USB Lithium System of tools that provides compact, portable and rechargeable solutions for cordless power and productivity.
